blurb: Cooperstown has baseball. Canton has football. Newport has sailing, and a museum that goes well beyond the trophy case. The Sailing Museum & National Sailing Hall of Fame traces the sport’s entire arc, while honoring the men and women whose championships and adventures shaped not just sailing, but how we think about courage, teamwork, and the open sea.
